description: EXPLORATORY gap-analysis of the per-pair EM-linking invariant for the pp-Coulomb T-³He split (OPEN gate of merged PR #1775). Tests whether any DERIVED dimensionless q-form (linking number, U(1)_framing, Markov-trace asymmetry, [2]_q α_EM lead, binding-link volume ratio) reproduces the remaining 3.2× factor. Finds NONE do (<1% gate); the factor decodes as a DIMENSIONFUL nuclear-charge-radius scale (r≈1.885 fm from AME vs ≈6.06 fm strong-bond proxy). 0.7638 MeV is POST-HOC; no fit, no tuning. RAW @ 40 dps. Audit: docs/audits/2026-06-03-em-linking-invariant.md

data.verdict: EM-linking STRUCTURE is derived (lk=+1=Q_pp, U(1)_framing q^{w·c}, Markov-trace asymmetry — all on main). But the per-pair Coulomb MAGNITUDE is DIMENSIONFUL: the 3.2× factor is the ratio of the nuclear-charge-radius Coulomb scale (r≈1.885 fm) to the strong-bond scale (r≈6.06 fm). NO derived dimensionless q-form matches it (<1% gate). The MISSING OBJECT is a categorical brane-separation / nuclear-charge-radius scale; any concrete value would be a CAL-4 fit to AME. PRECISE OBSTRUCTION — not a fit, not closed.
